tasks.objective: Run-lead visibility of task leads and workers. (1) plugin-flow-4: both task leads' 'task done' orchestration messages never reached the run lead, which sat idle ~7 h. Find why (orca orchestration send/--report-to target, delivery ids vs message ids, scripts/orca-wait.sh), fix it, and make `factory-pipeline.py status <plan>` show per task the last lead report and READY_FOR_PR so a run lead polling status sees completion without messages. (2) status --orca-run lists released workers as UNRELEASED: fix. (3) An abandoned QA worker's test run kept its test slot ~45 min: status/cleanup name the slot holders (PID, checkout, start) for the plan's worktrees; never kill a process the run cannot prove it started. (4) docs/plans/backlog.md released-worker-wsl-leftovers: cleanup names orphaned processes (wsl.exe sleep infinity etc.) that keep a task directory busy (PID, command, start time). (5) docs/plans/backlog.md tier-plan-arg. (6) docs/plans/backlog.md implementer-refusal-scope. (7) tests/pipeline.test.sh: --help prints usage and exits 0 without running, `--case ,` / empty case names exit 2, cli-selftest case (~61 s) made faster. (8) docs/plans/backlog.md orca-wait-lows. (9) Orca hides non-Orca worktrees when the repo's externalWorktreeVisibility is hide (the default here; maintainer 2026-11-10: task worktrees landed in 'Hidden worktrees' even with lineage set). dispatch --phase lead (and child placements) print `orca repo set --repo path:<repo> --external-worktree-visibility show` before the worktree add when `orca repo list --json` shows hide for that repo; delivery.md section 4 'Orca visibility' and the .claude/CLAUDE.md lesson name it. (10) verdict --fallback takes the unavailable agent, not the replacement, and its error 'claude is available now' is confusing (plugin-qa-lean): clearer usage text. (11) When Claude Code reaps a background waiter's shell (low memory, seen twice 2026-11-10), the orca-wait.sh process survives as an orphan and keeps its lock, so the next waiter exits 3 'already held': the lock holder exits when its parent dies, or the next waiter names the orphan PID. (12) docs/plans/backlog.md model-unavailable-probe: the Codex gateway wraps upstream errors in a 503 (body '[codex/<model>] [429]: The usage limit has been reached' or '[400] ... model_not_found'); the stall/route helpers map both to MODEL_UNAVAILABLE with the reason. Policy text (delivery.md section 8: the run lead polls status, never relies on messages alone) is written by a claude subtask. Backlog bookkeeping for these items is done by the run lead after merge.
acceptance: lead completion visible in status without messages (test)
slot holders and busy-dir processes named, never killed (test)
